comment: Example client configs for laptops on the same LAN. Replace 'your-mac.local' with your host's mDNS name or LAN IP, and the model id with whatever the host is serving.

generic_openai_sdk_python.code:
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(
    base_url='http://your-mac.local:8090/v1',
    api_key='local'
)

response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model='gemini/gemini-3.7-flash',
    messages=[{'role': 'user', 'content': 'Tell me a joke.'}]
)
print(response.choices[0].message.content)
